name: Brill
summary: In Brill, Forsaken gather north of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Newly awakened undead travel here from Deathknell, joining a rebuilt human town that now anchors Forsaken rule and arms in tirisfal glades.

sections.title: From Plague Ground to Bastion
sections.body:
Before the Third War, Brill grew under nobles such as the Barov and Agamand families. Then Kel'Thuzad chose the region for the Cult of the Damned's first experiments with the Plague of Undeath. The blight swept through the people so swiftly that the local militia fled. A vast graveyard remained for the dead.

Now Magistrate Sevren leads the Forsaken who have rebuilt Brill. Weathered Lordaeron buildings line its streets. The town coordinates defenses against Scarlet Crusade attacks, Scourge remnants, and native beasts changed by necromantic decay.

sections.title: Crossroads of Northern Lordaeron
sections.body: Brill links Tirisfal Glades to the wider Horde. Goblins operate the zeppelin tower, carrying travelers south toward Durotar and deep into Stranglethorn Vale. Gallows' End Tavern offers shelter. Its cellar also holds captured Scarlet zealots for interrogation and apothecarial testing.

aliases: who is in charge of brill
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren oversees Brill's civil administration and local defenses for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why is there such a massive graveyard outside Brill?
faq.answer: Kel'Thuzad carried out some of his first live experiments with the Plague of Undeath in Brill. The contagion killed the local human population so quickly that a mass graveyard was needed to bury the victims before they rose as Scourge.

faq.q: What is Gallows' End Tavern used for?
aliases: what is happening in the brill tavern
faq.answer: Gallows' End Tavern shelters weary travelers. In its cellar, apothecaries test chemicals and poisons on captured Scarlet Crusade zealots.

faq.q: Where does the zeppelin tower outside Brill travel to?
faq.answer: Goblin crews fly from Brill's zeppelin tower to Kalimdor outside orgrimmar, and south to grom'gol base camp in stranglethorn vale.

angles.text: For Forsaken leaving Deathknell, Brill offers the first glimpse of civilization and a place to prove loyalty to the Dark Lady.
Brill's zeppelin dock links the northern Horde with allied strongholds in Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
